name: xllm
description: Cross-vendor LLM advisors for Codex: ask claude or a local ollama/lmstudio model, or run a blind independent review across several, from inside a session. Read-only by default on adapters whose boundary is verified; debate/council are experimental.

interface.shortDescription: Cross-vendor LLM second opinions, read-only by default
interface.longDescription: Ask another vendor's CLI (claude) or local models (ollama, lmstudio) for independent opinions without leaving your session, or run a blind independent review across several and compare agreement. Advisors run read-only by default only where xllm can verify the boundary; same-vendor nesting is refused. debate/council are experimental.
defaultPrompt: Get a second opinion on this design from another model
Ask a local model to critique this API surface
Run a cross-vendor security review of this change
